acceptance_evidence: workflow_state.MissionTaskStateMachine persists immutable, contiguous plan versions beside existing runtime_tasks, validates references and acyclicity before insertion, rejects content-changing retry reuse, and admits work only when every durable dependency and legal base-task transition is ready; tests/test_durable_task_state_machine.py covers valid and invalid graphs plus repeated-claim refusal.

MissionCheckpointBinding atomically binds each checkpoint to plan/digest, canonical input, root/session/task authority, session/global policy generations, immutable budget contract, task state version and worker epoch. Resume and restart revalidate every binding against current grants, policy, budget, input and lease state while preserving completed output identities and avoiding repeated completed work.

Plan supersession and worker-epoch fencing deny stale checkpoint, output, completion and root-join writes. Required-output records are insert-only SHA-256 artifact references, completed nodes are not reclaimed, generic root recovery excludes independently leased mission nodes, and parent completion transactionally revalidates one successful current-plan join.

Durable join evaluation reports pending, partial, failed and succeeded states with explicit incomplete/failed task keys and missing required output names. Root success is refused until every required child output exists and the current join is successful; stale plans and workers cannot turn incomplete work into success.

runtime_persistence schema v4 adds six mission integrity tables through the existing transactional migration path. Populated v3-to-v4 and injected-failure tests preserve runs, runtime tasks, checkpoints and user data, leave no partial mission tables after rollback, and prove older schema targets reject v4 without mutation or destructive reset.

acceptance_evidence: AC1 — artifact bytes, input versions, producer/configuration and checks have verifiable identities: provenance entries record producer, producer version, config_sha256, named input versions and declared required checks, and identity_sha256 binds content plus those fields so a configuration or input change yields a different version identity; record_file_artifact re-hashes confined bytes instead of accepting a caller digest. Tests: test_identity_covers_the_producer_configuration_and_input_versions, test_identity_is_stable_across_input_ordering, test_the_recorded_identity_is_stored_so_a_reader_can_verify_it, test_identity_and_declared_checks_survive_a_restart, test_malformed_identities_are_refused.

AC2 — input changes invalidate affected descendants without deleting unrelated work: invalidate_for_inputs invalidates exactly the artifacts whose recorded input version moved and reuses the existing cascade for their derivatives; artifacts that never consumed the input, and artifacts already recording the new version, stay usable and are never deleted. Tests: test_an_input_version_change_invalidates_only_its_consumers, test_an_unchanged_input_version_invalidates_nothing, test_input_invalidation_cascades_to_derivatives_and_spares_siblings, test_an_empty_input_change_is_refused.

AC3 — path traversal, symlink escape, mismatched hashes and unsafe active previews are refused: confine_reference walks components with lstat and refuses parent traversal, absolute escape, symlinked files or directory components, directories and digest mismatch; check_preview refuses unknown, invalidated, untrusted, secret-without-allowance and changed content while reporting completeness. Tests: test_a_reference_inside_the_root_is_confined, test_parent_traversal_is_refused, test_an_absolute_reference_outside_the_root_is_refused, test_a_symlinked_file_is_refused, test_a_symlinked_directory_component_is_refused, test_a_mismatched_hash_is_refused, test_a_directory_is_not_an_artifact_reference, test_a_confined_preview_is_allowed_and_reports_completeness, test_an_unsafe_or_unowned_preview_is_refused, test_a_preview_of_an_invalidated_artifact_is_refused, test_a_preview_whose_bytes_changed_is_refused, test_a_confined_file_artifact_records_the_confined_identity.

AC4 — partial outputs and missing checks cannot appear accepted or complete: artifact_status reports complete only when declared checks exist and the newest outcome of each passed; require_complete raises for partial, unchecked, failed and invalidated artifacts; a check recorded after invalidation cannot resurrect an artifact; exports carry complete=False with missing checks. Tests: test_an_artifact_without_declared_checks_is_never_complete, test_missing_and_failed_checks_are_reported_by_name, test_a_pass_on_one_check_cannot_cover_a_failure_on_another, test_a_re_run_supersedes_the_outcome_but_keeps_the_history, test_checks_after_invalidation_cannot_resurrect_the_artifact, test_an_unknown_artifact_or_outcome_is_refused, test_export_marks_partial_output_and_refuses_invalidated_output.

AC5 — retention/export/delete preserve privacy and scoped reference history: export_artifact gates on confidentiality and the deny-wins verdict and appends history; delete_artifact requires confirmation and a reason, refuses pins, valid evidence and current descendants, and leaves a tombstone with identity plus scoped reference history but no content and no free-form source_ref; existing retention protection still governs collection. Tests: test_export_refuses_secret_content_until_it_is_explicitly_allowed, test_deletion_needs_confirmation_a_reason_and_no_live_dependants, test_valid_evidence_blocks_deletion, test_deletion_leaves_a_scoped_tombstone_without_content_or_source_reference, test_deleting_secret_content_needs_an_explicit_allowance, plus retention regressions test_retention_collects_only_what_nothing_depends_on, test_evidence_still_in_force_pins_its_subject, test_confidential_content_is_kept_unless_explicitly_allowed.

Migration — a populated schema v1 store keeps every record: test_a_populated_v1_store_is_upgraded_without_losing_records proves entries, evidence and pins survive, the next atomic write stamps schema 2, and v1 artifacts honestly report checks_not_declared rather than complete; test_a_newer_store_schema_is_refused_rather_than_downgraded proves fail-closed refusal. tests/test_durable_state_contract.py still asserts the shared owner-only, atomic-replace, symlink-refusal, corrupt/future-version contract for the store at schema 2.

blast_radius.objective_and_gap: Make checked artifacts the unit of delivery: bytes, input versions, producer/configuration and declared checks must carry verifiable identities; input changes must invalidate only affected descendants; traversal, symlink escape, digest mismatch and unsafe active previews must be refused; partial outputs and missing checks must not read as accepted or complete; retention/export/delete must preserve privacy and scoped reference history. M5-P5-02 already provides content digests, deduplicated provenance, deny-wins operation verdicts, cascade invalidation, evidence freshness and retention, but has no producer/config/input identity, no required-check completeness state, no confined file/preview reference type, no input-change-driven invalidation, and no scoped export/delete that preserves reference history.
blast_radius.options: (a) Add a second artifact/identity module and store — rejected: competing store and control plane for the same bytes. (b) Extend the existing artifact_lineage store additively with a v1-to-v2 schema migration and typed helpers, reusing ArtifactRegistry's secure write path, operation verdicts and retention — chosen as the smallest complete slice. (c) Declare AP-006 satisfied by M5-P5-02 — rejected: docs/autonomous-production-ap001-reconciliation.md records these exact gaps.
blast_radius.anticipated_files: artifact_lineage.py (primary), tests/test_artifact_lineage.py (anchor) plus a new focused test module, docs/artifact-lineage.md, docs/storage-migrations.md, a new ADR, the AP tracking ledger, AGENTS.md and regenerated source-bound artifacts. app.py, routes, static/index.html and the UI inventory are untouched: no new endpoint or control, so no widening of the API surface.
blast_radius.contracts_and_data: Additive artifact-lineage schema v2 in the existing artifacts/state.json sidecar: optional producer kind/version, producer configuration digest, named input digests, named required checks with outcomes, plus top-level export and deletion (tombstone) history. No new store file, no duplicated bytes, no caller-supplied authority or completion fields accepted as truth.
blast_radius.authority_and_resources: No credentials, provider/model inference, network egress, browser worker, account, billable action, background process or new filesystem grant. File references are confined to a caller-supplied root that the caller already owns; the store keeps its owner-only permissions and symlink refusal. Tests stay offline on temporary directories.
blast_radius.compatibility_and_rollback: A populated v1 store is read, migrated in memory to v2 with every entry, evidence record and pin preserved, and written as v2 by the existing atomic replace path — no destructive reset. A v1 binary refuses the v2 file loudly instead of silently dropping identity fields, so rollback is either re-applying the newer module or restoring a snapshot taken before upgrade; the module never deletes data to recover.
blast_radius.required_evidence: Positive/negative identity tests (producer, config, inputs, checks); selective-invalidation tests proving affected descendants go invalid while unrelated artifacts keep working; traversal, symlink-escape, digest-mismatch and unsafe-preview refusals; partial-output and missing-check refusal to report complete; export/delete privacy plus preserved reference history; populated v1 store migration and stale-evidence interaction; existing lineage, durable-state-contract, trusted-transformation and quarantine regressions; static checks and generated-artifact drift.

stories.title: Implement bounded execution, cancellation and truthful recovery
stories.objective: Make autonomous work stop, resume and report failure honestly.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation stops dispatch and terminates owned work with measured cleanup latency
Late outputs are fenced; unresolved external effects remain uncertain and require reconciliation
No-progress, repeated repair, deadline and memory/storage exhaustion stop boundedly
Runtime isolation absence blocks dependent execution rather than switching to host shell
User receives retained partial artifacts and an actionable limitation instead of false success
implementation_rules: Read current producer/authority/executor/consumer paths; module existence is not integration proof.
Document alternatives, affected surfaces, pinned tests, risks and rollback before edits.
Reuse existing authority and persistence; no bypass or competing control plane.
Add positive, negative and failure/recovery coverage appropriate to the change.
Preserve existing features, regenerate affected artifacts and report skipped/blocked evidence honestly.
required_evidence: Exact base/head SHA and changed-file list
Acceptance criterion to test/artifact mapping
Executed commands, exit codes, environment and sanitized evidence paths
Permission/egress/resource implications and rollback/migration evidence
Generated artifact freshness and applicable CI results
Push/PR state; owner/independent approvals where required

acceptance_evidence: AC1 cancellation stops dispatch and terminates owned work with measured cleanup latency: workflow_state.DurableTaskStateMachine.halt_mission stops one plan version in one transaction (every owned unfinished task, including delegated descendants: lease fenced, in-flight consequential actions uncertain, budget cancel flag set, task cancelled), fences the halted leases at the process layer and, with a ProcessSupervisor, terminates the registered processes and records dispatch_fenced_ms, cleanup_latency_ms and slowest_process_ms from the stop request. Tests in tests/test_durable_task_state_machine.py: test_ap007_cancellation_stops_dispatch_and_terminates_owned_work_with_measured_latency, test_ap007_cleanup_latency_is_measured_from_the_stop_request, test_ap007_halt_reaches_delegated_descendants_and_their_processes, test_ap007_containment_retry_never_upgrades_a_lingering_stop_without_evidence, test_ap007_lingering_count_without_identities_is_carried_forward, test_ap007_containment_failure_is_reported_and_the_durable_stop_stands, test_ap007_halt_rejects_unknown_plans_wrong_identity_and_finished_versions; tests/test_process_supervision.py::test_still_running_reports_only_the_same_live_process. Terminated processes are local fixture subprocesses started by the tests.

AC2 late outputs are fenced and unresolved effects stay uncertain until reconciled: side_effect_ledger.DurableActionLedger.complete and record_exception leave an uncertain action unchanged; execution_spine.DurableActionBoundary returns ok false, uncertain true, error_code late_result_fenced; only resolve_uncertain_action resolves; create_mission_plan raises MissionHaltUnsettled until every uncertain action is reconciled and a supervised stop is clean. Tests: test_ap007_late_results_are_fenced_and_unresolved_effects_stay_uncertain, test_ap007_stopped_plan_must_be_settled_before_new_work_is_planned, test_ap007_halted_plan_is_not_revived_by_recovery_or_resume (state machine); test_ap007_late_result_cannot_settle_an_action_already_declared_uncertain, test_ap007_boundary_reports_a_fenced_late_result_as_uncertain_not_success (tests/test_durable_intent_ledger.py). The fence is on the live action path and applies to every task: before this change a late result overwrote the uncertain verdict. Follow-up AP-007-F1 (post_completion_changes, PR #307): the fence applies to mission-owned work only. The two tests/test_durable_intent_ledger.py cases named here keep their names and assert it on a stopped mission task. Work that no mission owns is finalized by its late result as before AP-007, pinned by test_ap007_late_result_for_work_no_mission_owns_is_recorded_as_before, test_ap007_late_result_is_recorded_on_a_store_without_mission_tables and test_ap007_boundary_passes_a_late_result_through_for_work_no_mission_owns.

AC3 no-progress, repeated repair, deadline and memory/storage exhaustion stop boundedly: optional max_no_progress, max_repair_attempts, deadline_at, max_memory_bytes and max_storage_bytes in the existing budget document, plus measurement_unavailable for a declared ceiling that cannot be read; the stop reason is committed before BoundedStopRequired is raised; counters and peaks stop on strictly greater than the limit and the deadline at the deadline. Tests: test_ap007_declared_limits_stop_the_mission_boundedly, test_ap007_deadline_stops_claims_dispatch_and_resume_without_any_observation, test_ap007_one_task_at_its_limit_stops_the_plan_with_task_scope, test_ap007_unmeasurable_ceiling_stops_until_a_real_reading_arrives, test_ap007_stale_or_fenced_workers_cannot_record_observations, test_ap007_control_operations_keep_bounded_counters (state machine); the 25 AP-007 cases in tests/test_execution_budget.py, including unchanged stored documents and identity digests for budgets that declare no new limit.

AC4 runtime isolation absence blocks dependent execution rather than switching to the host shell: a budget can declare isolation_required; claims and resumes raise MissionIsolationRejected and every dispatch charge raises IsolationUnavailable anywhere in the task chain unless IsolationEvidence proves sandbox mode, literal admission, a literally qualified backend and a backend id. The app tool boundary answers isolation_unavailable, debits no tool call and writes no file. No production caller presents isolation evidence, so such a mission is always refused in this build; the accepting path runs only with a test fixture. Tests: test_ap007_missing_isolation_blocks_dependent_execution_without_host_fallback, test_ap007_cancellation_and_isolation_bind_the_whole_task_chain (state machine); test_ap007_isolation_needs_literal_proof_and_has_no_host_fallback (budget); tests/test_mission_authority_envelope.py::test_ap007_required_isolation_and_bounded_stops_deny_dispatch_at_the_tool_boundary. Not shown: execution on a qualified backend or installed-runtime qualification (NOT RUN on this host under the owner’s waiver); no production evidence caller or acceptance exists, and no activation is authorized.

AC5 the user receives retained partial artifacts and an actionable limitation instead of false success: mission_recovery_report lists retained outputs per task with their artifact verdict, unresolved action ids and one next action per limitation; claims_success is true only when the outcome is succeeded and no limitation remains; reports are stored as hash-addressed rows in runtime_mission_joins. Tests: test_ap007_recovery_report_claims_success_only_for_checked_complete_artifacts, test_ap007_report_names_a_required_stop_that_nobody_carried_out, and the report assertions in the cancellation and bounded-stop cases. No user interface or route surfaces the report; that is later owner-authorized work.

blast_radius.objective_and_gap: Make mission work stop, resume and report failure honestly. Reading the current code shows the pieces exist per task or per process but are not joined at mission scope. workflow_state.cancel_task already fences root and direct-child epochs and turns in-flight consequential actions uncertain, and claim_ready_mission_task already refuses a cancelled or exhausted root; process_supervision already measures bounded terminate/kill/reap per supervised record; complete_mission_task already refuses a stale epoch and unresolved consequential actions; recovery_guard already bounds retries and detects stagnation per task; sandbox_boundary already refuses unqualified backends. Missing: one mission-scoped cancellation that stops dispatch, contains every owned supervised process of the mission and reports a single measured cleanup latency with durable evidence; memory and storage exhaustion limits (execution_budget has none), plus no-progress, repair-attempt and wall-clock deadline limits bound to AP-005 mission tasks and stopped boundedly with the reason committed before the refusal; a mission-level isolation gate that refuses dependent work instead of ever using the host; and a truthful recovery report that names retained partial artifacts, uncertain effects needing reconciliation and an actionable limitation instead of success.
blast_radius.options: (a) A new mission supervisor, scheduler loop or second state store — rejected: competing control plane beside workflow_state, execution_budget and process_supervision (roadmap section 3 forbids it). (b) Extend the existing owners additively: optional bounded-stop limits and counters inside runtime_tasks.budget_json through execution_budget, mission-scoped cancel/stop/report methods on workflow_state.DurableTaskStateMachine, and reuse of ProcessSupervisor containment and its measured TerminationOutcome — chosen as the smallest complete slice. (c) Declare AP-007 satisfied by M5-P3-03/M5-P2-05/M5-P1-05 — rejected: docs/autonomous-production-ap001-reconciliation.md and issue #301 record these exact mission-wide gaps. (d) Wait for U06 — rejected for the fail-closed subset: the decision register lists refusal, cancellation and uncertain-effect tests as safe work that assumes no outcome.
blast_radius.anticipated_files: execution_budget.py and workflow_state.py (primary); process_supervision.py, sandbox_boundary.py, side_effect_ledger.py, recovery_guard.py and artifact_lineage.py only where a small additive seam is unavoidable; tests/test_execution_budget.py, tests/test_durable_task_state_machine.py and a focused AP-007 test module; docs/durable-mission-graphs.md or a new bounded-execution document, a new ADR, docs/autonomous-production-ap001-reconciliation.md, this ledger, AGENTS.md and regenerated source-bound artifacts (studio.py and dependent evidence). No route, endpoint, static/index.html control or UI inventory change is planned, so the API surface is not widened.
blast_radius.contracts_and_data: Additive, optional keys inside the existing runtime_tasks.budget_json document; no new table, store file or SQLite schema version is planned. Limits are emitted only when declared, so the budget identity hashed by runtime_persistence.compute_task_budget_identity is unchanged for every existing task and mission binding, while declaring a new limit is an authority-changing budget update that invalidates captured bindings as today. Cancellation and bounded-stop evidence goes to the existing runtime_task_transitions evidence_json. No artifact bytes, prompts or secrets are stored; reports carry identifiers, digests, counts and durations only.
blast_radius.authority_and_resources: No credential, provider or model inference, network egress, browser worker, account, billable action, background process or new filesystem grant. Mission cancellation needs the typed server-created AP-004 MissionAuthorityEnvelope, never request JSON or model arguments. Memory and storage readings are supplied by the caller or measured read-only on already-owned processes and confined paths; an unavailable reading for a declared limit stops the work rather than assuming headroom. Isolation that is absent, unqualified, stale or under incident refuses dependent execution and never selects the host shell.
blast_radius.compatibility_and_rollback: Existing budget documents parse unchanged and keep their identity digest; a task without the new limits behaves exactly as before. Rollback is a source revert: an older binary ignores unknown optional keys only if none were written, so the candidate must prove with a test what an older reader does with a document that carries the new keys, and document that outcome instead of assuming it. No data is deleted, no destructive reset is used, and cancel/stop transitions append history rather than rewrite it.
blast_radius.required_evidence: Positive and negative tests for mission cancellation (dispatch refused afterwards, owned fixture subprocesses terminated, one measured cleanup latency recorded); stale and race tests (late completion, late checkpoint and late spawn after cancel are fenced; a second cancel is idempotent); uncertain consequential effects stay uncertain and block completion until reconciled; bounded stops for no-progress, repeated repair, deadline, memory and storage including the unavailable-measurement case and restart persistence of the committed stop reason; isolation-absent refusal with proof that no host execution path ran; truthful report tests proving a stopped mission never reads as succeeded and lists retained partial artifacts with a limitation; budget-identity compatibility for existing documents; existing budget, mission, supervision, side-effect, sandbox, recovery-guard and artifact-lineage regressions; static checks and generated-artifact drift.

blast_radius.objective_and_gap: The landed isolation gate is opt-in. execution_budget.charge_hierarchical_tool_call asks for isolation proof only when a budget in the task chain declares isolation_required. Only server code can declare it and nothing does, so a mission that declares nothing dispatches consequential actions with no sandbox admission. The proof (IsolationEvidence) needs sandbox mode, a literal admission, a literal qualification and a backend id. It is not compared with a recorded container runtime and image, it carries no qualification identity or date, and one kind of proof covers all work. The owner's U06 answers 1 to 4 ask for the opposite on each point, and answer 6 does not accept the subset as the refusal foundation. AP-007 acceptance criterion concerned: “Runtime isolation absence blocks dependent execution rather than switching to host shell”.
blast_radius.options: Where to gate: (a) at the atomic budget charge, by ownership and action class: when the task chain contains a task of a mission plan and the action is consequential, require proof whether or not isolation_required is declared — chosen: the charge is the last admission step before durable intent and dispatch, it already runs in one transaction with the chain loaded, and ownership is the rule the mission stop and the fence use. (b) Have create_mission_plan write isolation_required into every plan budget — rejected: it changes the budget identity of existing plans, it also covers read-only actions, and a budget written without the key would again be ungated. (c) Gate in workflow_orchestration or in a new mission dispatcher — rejected: no mission dispatcher exists, and a second admission path would compete with the action boundary. (d) Gate every task-bound consequential action — rejected: the owner limited the scope to mission-owned work, and it would refuse consequential tool calls of the running application on a default install. What counts as proof: (e) an acceptance record held by the budget manager and absent by default, naming the accepted container runtime, runtime version and image digest, the earliest acceptable qualification time and the activated steps — chosen: what is accepted is fixed when the server composes the manager, it is not supplied per dispatch, and its absence refuses everything. (f) Read the AP operating-envelope JSON at run time — rejected: a planning document would become a runtime dependency. (g) Hard-code the M5-P3-01 values — rejected: the owner asks for a fresh qualification before U06 can be recorded as satisfied, so no value is accepted yet.

authorization_record.scope_limit: Mission-owned work only, as in AP-007-F2. The isolation gate judges proof for a consequential action whose task is a task of a mission plan or a descendant of one, and for a budget that declares isolation_required (only server code can declare it and nothing does). For every other action the budget charge, the action boundary, the action ledger and the sandbox admission of the running application answer as they do on main. Offline and fail closed: no production caller records an acceptance, builds evidence or observes the host, so in this build every consequential action of mission-owned work stays refused. Where the design is more specific than the selected option text: (1) “refuse a qualification report that has no generation time” means that the mission gate refuses proof that rests on such a report. The sandbox layer still records the report for the application, as it does today, and marks the record. (2) “the recorded target host” is identified by a digest of the machine description that a qualification report already carries: operating system, architecture, processor model, processor count and memory size. It is not a unique hardware identifier, and two machines of the same model and memory size are not told apart. Proof needs two host values that equal the recorded one: the host of the qualification run, taken from the qualification record, and the host the server observed for the dispatch. Nothing observes the host in this build. (3) “state that consequential work is refused” is one limitation in the recovery report of a live plan that still owes work and is neither cancelled nor stopped; the outcome of the report does not change. (4) “an additive change in sandbox_boundary.py” is two fields with defaults on the qualification record. They are also visible in the store file and in the JSON that the security-incident routes already return for a qualification. Not changed: the mission stop, the bounded limits, the late-result fence, the outcomes of the recovery report, the HTTP 400 for the six budget keys, the verdict of SecurityIncidentStore.check_admission, and which qualification reports the security-incident routes accept. No route, table, column or schema version is added. runtime_activation_authorized stays false and U06 stays pending. Not part of this follow-up: work of a later step that no mission owns, a production acceptance or production evidence, and the U06 call-path audit page. Whether the rework, with or without this follow-up, is accepted as the refusal foundation is the owner's decision; this entry does not claim it.

blast_radius.objective_and_gap: Three items of the not-delivered list of ADR-0043. (1) sandbox_boundary._sb_evaluate_qualification_evidence gives a qualification report that states no generation time the time of ingestion, and the qualification record does not say that it did. IsolationEvidence.from_admission takes the earlier of the record time and the report time. For such a report both are the ingestion time, so an undated report counts as a fresh qualification. (2) IsolationAcceptance pins a runtime, a runtime version, an image digest, a time and steps, but no host, and the qualification record does not say on which machine its report was produced. A report produced on another machine, or a security store copied from another machine, satisfies the gate. The owner's U06 answer 2 asks for a qualification run on the target host. (3) mission_recovery_report mentions isolation only when the root budget declares isolation_required. For a plan that declares nothing, every consequential action is refused at the charge, and the report answers in_progress without a word about it. AP-007 acceptance criteria concerned: “Runtime isolation absence blocks dependent execution rather than switching to host shell” and “User receives retained partial artifacts and an actionable limitation instead of false success”.
blast_radius.options: Undated report: (a) the qualification record says whether its report stated a generation time of its own (a field that defaults to no), the evidence adapter takes a qualification time only from a record that says yes, and evidence without a usable time is refused with its own reason — chosen: the application's admission does not read the field, and a record written before the change fails closed for missions. (b) Reject an undated report when it is ingested — rejected: that changes the admission of the running application and three security-incident routes. (c) Record no time for an undated report — rejected: the sandbox layer compares that time in its post-incident freshness check and returns it in the qualification object, so the change would alter what the application does and shows. Target host: (d) the acceptance names the host as a digest of a machine description; the qualification record keeps the digest of its report's machine description; the evidence carries the host of the qualification run and the host the server observed; both must equal the accepted one — chosen. (e) Compare only the host of the qualification run — rejected: a security store copied to another machine would still pass. (f) A unique hardware identifier — rejected: the qualification report carries none, collecting one changes the M5-P3-01 suite and stores a new hardware identifier, and the machine description the suite already binds its record to is enough to refuse a report from a different kind of machine. (g) Add the operating-system release to the identity — rejected: no rule is decided for requalification after an update, and the runtime version and the image are pinned separately. (h) Add a function that observes the host — not done here: nothing builds evidence in production, and the macOS readings cannot be verified on the authoring host; it belongs to the activation wiring. Recovery report: (i) one limitation with its own code for a live plan that still owes work and is neither cancelled nor stopped, judged by the same isolation_refusal and the same acceptance as the charge; the outcome stays in_progress — chosen. (j) Report such a plan blocked — rejected: read-only actions are still charged, and the report cannot know whether the remaining tasks need a consequential action. (k) Reuse the code isolation_unavailable — rejected: its next action says the mission cannot run. (l) Say it for cancelled and stopped plans as well — rejected: those reports already say that the plan runs no further.

blast_radius.options: (a) Import scripts/qualify_environment into sandbox_boundary - rejected: layering violation and studio.py standalone inlining (scripts is not an inlined sibling; the qualification suite imports app.py). (b) platform.uname or a macOS-only read - rejected: a different value set than the qualification report binds; the gate compares against qualification_host_fingerprint of the report's fingerprint block, so the observed value must be the digest of the same five values. (c) A unique hardware identifier (serial, UUID) - rejected: ADR-0044 deliberately digests only the five values; collecting more violates the minimal-identifier rule and changes what is stored on disk. (d) Observe at import/module load - rejected: no host read at import; lazy and call-time only, and any failure must degrade to refusal, which an import-time probe cannot express. (e) A full contained-execution dispatch caller and mission runtime now - rejected for this slice: no mission caller exists in the running application, defining one is new API surface and a mission runtime (AP-008 and later territory), and it could not be qualified on this Linux host without a container runtime; the owner's activation order activates contained execution only with its own recorded evidence, which does not exist. (f) A separate subprocess for every Darwin field - rejected: one bounded shell-free sysctl invocation can read the same three OIDs, reducing process overhead without changing the qualification suite value set; non-Darwin readers use /proc.

stories.title: Add source-backed safe search, reading and repository inspection
stories.objective: Research missing information with provenance and enforced public-source boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Sources record URL, retrieval date, publication date if known and supporting excerpts/provenance
Unsupported facts, missing dates and contradictions remain explicit
Private/loopback/link-local/metadata access and redirect/DNS bypasses are blocked at the network boundary
External instructions cannot expand grants or trigger installation
Repository inspection is read-only and respects request/download/storage budgets
Provider access failure yields honest incomplete research, not invented citations
implementation_rules: Read current producer/authority/executor/consumer paths; module existence is not integration proof.
Document alternatives, affected surfaces, pinned tests, risks and rollback before edits.
Reuse existing authority and persistence; no bypass or competing control plane.
Add positive, negative and failure/recovery coverage appropriate to the change.
Preserve existing features, regenerate affected artifacts and report skipped/blocked evidence honestly.
required_evidence: Exact base/head SHA and changed-file list
Acceptance criterion to test/artifact mapping
Executed commands, exit codes, environment and sanitized evidence paths
Permission/egress/resource implications and rollback/migration evidence
Generated artifact freshness and applicable CI results
Push/PR state; owner/independent approvals where required

acceptance_evidence: AC1 every source records URL, retrieval date, publication date if known, and supporting excerpts/provenance: SourceRecord carries url, final_url (after the validated redirect chain), retrieved_at, http_status, content_sha256, a bounded excerpt, byte_count and publication_date; publication_date is derived only from source-supplied evidence (Date/Last-Modified) and stays None otherwise. Tests: test_ok_fetch_records_provenance_and_publication_date, test_missing_publication_date_stays_none, test_bundle_to_dict_is_json_serializable_and_honest.

AC2 unsupported facts, missing dates and contradictions remain explicit: add_claim without a supporting source stays 'unsupported'; record_contradiction requires >=2 sources and marks the claim 'contradicted' without reconciling; failed/partial/refused sources stay on the bundle and are listed by incomplete_reason(). Tests: test_claim_without_supporting_source_is_unsupported, test_contradiction_requires_two_sources_and_marks_claim, test_http_500_is_failed_and_marks_bundle_incomplete.

AC3 private/loopback/link-local/metadata access and redirect/DNS bypasses are blocked at the network boundary: PUBLIC_READ_ALLOWLIST is exactly the six U03 hosts; https only, port 443 only, userinfo refused; blocked v4/v6 ranges including 169.254.169.254, CGNAT, documentation, benchmark, multicast, reserved and IPv4-mapped v6; allowlisted hosts are DNS-checked and fail closed when any answer is blocked; redirects are validated hop-by-hop with a cap and a fetcher final_url that disagrees with the chain is refused. Tests: the is_blocked_ip parametrisation, test_allowlisted_host_resolving_to_private_dns_is_refused, test_redirect_crossing_to_private_ip_is_refused, test_redirect_crossing_allowlist_is_refused, test_redirect_chain_length_cap, test_final_url_mismatch_with_chain_is_refused, test_literal_metadata_host_is_refused.

AC4 external instructions cannot expand grants or trigger installation: the module holds no installation, activation, account, spend or publishing path; fetched content is handled only as bounded text bytes/excerpts and never interpreted; the allowlist is a module constant that no fetched input can widen. Tests: test_allowlist_contains_exactly_the_u03_standard_public_set, test_non_allowlist_host_is_refused, test_http_scheme_is_refused, test_url_with_userinfo_is_refused, test_non_443_port_is_refused.

AC5 repository inspection is read-only and budget-respecting: inspect_repository refuses symlinks and never writes, enforces max_files / max_file_bytes / max_total_bytes, records sha256 per regular file and sets truncated when a cap stops the walk. Tests: test_repo_inspection_is_read_only_and_bounded (before/after tree equality), test_repo_inspection_refuses_symlinks_outside_root, test_repo_inspection_enforces_per_file_and_total_budgets, test_repo_inspection_per_file_cap.

AC6 provider failure yields honest incomplete research, never invented citations: fetcher exceptions and HTTP 5xx become failed SourceRecords; a failed provider leaves claims unsupported and the bundle incomplete with reasons; adapters never fabricate results from an unparseable payload. Tests: test_fetcher_exception_is_failed_not_raised, test_provider_failure_never_invents_a_citation, test_github_search_bad_json_is_partial_and_lists_no_repos, test_dns_resolver_failure_refuses_not_raises.

Deliverables: search/read adapters (github_search_repositories via api.github.com, wikipedia_raw_article via en.wikipedia.org, both over the injected boundary), claim/source and contradiction records, and hostile-source/redirect/download coverage (oversize-body truncation, non-UTF8 replacement decoding, redirect and DNS bypasses, HTTP 5xx).

Self-review defect fix (post-delivery, same story): the first delivery parsed GitHub search JSON from the human-readable excerpt, which is capped at 4000 characters, so a valid 5.7 KB response returned zero repositories as an ordinary result; adapters now parse the retained byte-capped body via guarded_fetch_with_body, which is the same body hashed into the record. The same review found adapters ignoring the caller's SourceBudget and fetching at the 512 KiB default; they now pass bundle.budget through. Truncation is explicit through a new upstream_byte_count field. Regression tests: test_github_search_parses_payload_larger_than_the_excerpt_budget, test_github_search_parsing_does_not_depend_on_content_type, test_github_search_on_source_cap_parses_nothing_and_says_so, test_github_search_json_array_payload_is_partial_with_no_repos, test_truncated_source_record_reports_upstream_and_retained_bytes, test_untruncated_source_record_has_equal_byte_counts.

stories.title: Qualify a controlled browser worker and human takeover
stories.objective: Evaluate Browser Use/direct Playwright through a narrow governed worker interface.
acceptance_criteria: Compare candidate versus deterministic browser baseline on the same tasks
Each project uses an isolated profile/context; no automatic personal-profile reuse
All navigation/download/tool activity remains within grants and nested budgets
Authenticated takeover pauses conflicting agent actions and safely resumes
Hostile pages, private-network attempts and unexpected popups cannot obtain added authority
Stop/restart closes or recovers owned browser jobs and session state without secret leakage
implementation_rules: Read current producer/authority/executor/consumer paths; module existence is not integration proof.
Document alternatives, affected surfaces, pinned tests, risks and rollback before edits.
Reuse existing authority and persistence; no bypass or competing control plane.
Add positive, negative and failure/recovery coverage appropriate to the change.
Preserve existing features, regenerate affected artifacts and report skipped/blocked evidence honestly.
required_evidence: Exact base/head SHA and changed-file list
Acceptance criterion to test/artifact mapping
Executed commands, exit codes, environment and sanitized evidence paths
Permission/egress/resource implications and rollback/migration evidence
Generated artifact freshness and applicable CI results
Push/PR state; owner/independent approvals where required

acceptance_evidence: AC1 candidate versus deterministic baseline on the same tasks: BakeOffHarness runs identical TaskScripts through a baseline and a candidate driver under one SessionPolicy and compares only policy-visible outcomes (executed, refused, failures, bytes), so a candidate cannot win by exceeding the grant. Tests: test_bakeoff_reports_equivalence_when_both_drivers_agree, test_bakeoff_exposes_divergence_when_the_candidate_fails, test_bakeoff_counts_refusals_identically_and_never_widens_policy. Real browser: test_real_two_runs_are_deterministic. No scored Browser Use vs Playwright winner is claimed; that needs hosted/credentialed environments U03 excludes.

AC2 isolated profile per project, no personal-profile reuse: allocate_profile mints a fresh profile per session; assert_not_personal_profile refuses personal application/config roots by name and every known browser user-data marker. Tests: test_profile_is_allocated_inside_the_workspace, the test_personal_profiles_are_refused parametrisation, test_personal_application_roots_are_refused, test_two_sessions_never_share_a_profile, test_ephemeral_temp_root_under_home_is_allowed. Real browser: test_real_profile_is_isolated_and_removed.

AC3 navigation/download/tool activity within grants and nested budgets: every BrowserAction is admitted before the driver sees it; origins, navigation count and downloads are explicit grants; a download must declare its size; the per-download cap and the session's nested byte budget both apply; a driver writing past the cap is a violation. Tests: test_navigation_outside_granted_origin_is_refused, test_navigation_budget_is_enforced_before_the_driver_sees_it, test_downloads_are_off_by_default, test_download_requires_a_declared_size, test_download_respects_nested_byte_budget, test_per_download_cap_is_enforced, test_driver_writing_more_than_the_cap_is_a_violation, test_refused_action_never_reaches_the_driver. Real browser: test_real_navigation_click_type_and_screenshot.

AC4 authenticated takeover pauses conflicting agent actions and resumes safely: take_over suspends all agent actions, resume requires the same identified human, double takeover and foreign resume raise, and actions during takeover are denied naming the holder. Tests: test_takeover_suspends_agent_actions, test_resume_by_the_same_human_restores_control, test_a_different_human_cannot_resume, test_double_takeover_is_refused, test_resume_without_takeover_is_refused, test_takeover_requires_an_identified_human. Real browser: test_real_takeover_then_stop.

AC5 hostile pages, private-network attempts and unexpected popups cannot obtain added authority: private/link-local/metadata targets are refused even when a grant names them; loopback passes only for an explicitly granted local origin; file:, javascript: and chrome: are refused; popups are denied by default and constrained to the opener origin and off private space when granted; in the real browser a popup is recorded, closed, and the surviving surface list proves it never became a window. Tests: test_private_network_navigation_is_refused, test_file_and_javascript_schemes_are_refused, test_url_with_userinfo_is_refused, test_popups_are_refused_by_default, test_popup_to_other_origin_is_refused_even_when_granted, test_popup_to_private_network_is_refused, test_private_targets_are_detected. Real browser: test_real_popup_is_refused_and_closed, test_real_private_target_is_refused_before_dispatch.

AC6 stop/restart closes or recovers owned browser jobs and session state without secret leakage: stop fences the session, closes the driver even when it throws, destroys the owned profile, and is idempotent; a fenced session refuses to dispatch; recovery requires a fresh profile and a new policy and restores no prior budget; secret-shaped journal fields are redacted on write and on serialisation. Tests: test_stop_fences_the_session_and_closes_the_driver, test_stop_destroys_the_owned_profile, test_stop_is_idempotent, test_driver_failure_on_stop_still_fences, test_stopped_session_cannot_be_revived_in_place, test_recovery_needs_a_fresh_profile_and_never_restores_authority, test_recovery_of_a_live_session_is_refused, test_journal_redacts_secret_shaped_fields.

Deliverables: browser adapter bake-off (BakeOffHarness plus the real-driver determinism run), dedicated session and takeover controls (BrowserSession, SessionPolicy, ProfileRecord), and real-browser cancellation/privacy evidence (tests/test_browser_worker_real.py against the pinned Chromium).

acceptance_evidence: AC1 missing facts, method, model capability, context, tool and hardware are distinguished: classify_gap maps six distinct signals to six distinct GapKind values, reports the cheapest applicable explanation when several are present, refuses unrecognised signals, and marks only model/tool/hardware gaps as needing a new dependency. Tests: the test_each_signal_maps_to_its_own_kind parametrisation, test_missing_facts_is_never_treated_as_a_dependency_problem, test_cheapest_explanation_wins_when_several_signals_are_present, test_unknown_signal_is_refused.

AC2 discovery can conclude that no new dependency is needed: empty signals return NO_GAP; a registry with NO_GAP refuses to register candidates rather than inventing a dependency; a gap whose remedy is collecting evidence or changing method recommends no_new_dependency even with candidates registered; a gap with no viable candidate reports BLOCKED without inventing one. Tests: test_no_signals_means_no_gap, test_registry_without_gap_cannot_register_candidates, test_registry_without_gap_recommends_no_new_dependency, test_a_gap_that_needs_no_dependency_recommends_none_even_with_candidates, test_hardware_gap_with_no_candidates_reports_blocked_without_inventing_one.

AC3 candidates record source revision, maintenance, license, install hooks, resource cost, egress and privileges: CapabilityCandidate requires all six surfaces plus identity fields; unknown maintenance reports None rather than assuming health; archived candidates flag stale; install-time network access blocks; install hooks and out-of-allowlist egress are flagged. Tests: test_candidate_records_the_full_surface, the test_candidate_requires_its_identity_fields parametrisation, test_unknown_maintenance_is_unknown_not_optimistic, test_archived_candidate_is_flagged_stale, test_install_hooks_are_recorded_and_warned_about, test_network_at_install_time_blocks_the_candidate, test_egress_outside_the_allowlist_is_flagged_and_blocked_for_reuse.

AC4 directory stars and MCP annotations never establish trust: popularity is stored as an untrusted claim, establish_trust raises when stars, download counts or MCP annotations are offered as evidence, a trust basis without named evidence is refused, and every serialised candidate states popularity_establishes_trust false. Tests: test_popularity_never_establishes_trust, test_stars_as_evidence_are_rejected, test_mcp_annotation_as_evidence_is_rejected, test_download_counts_are_rejected_as_evidence, test_verified_evidence_establishes_trust, test_a_trust_basis_without_evidence_is_refused.

AC5 unlicensed or incompatible candidates are blocked for the affected reuse rather than installed: unlicensed ('nobody said') and unknown ('not reviewed') are distinct statuses that both block; copyleft stays usable internally while blocking redistribution, bundling and (for AGPL) network service; a blocked candidate cannot hide an acceptable one; the registry has no install path at all. Tests: test_missing_license_is_unlicensed_and_blocks_every_reuse, test_unreviewed_license_is_unknown_and_blocks, test_copyleft_allows_internal_use_but_blocks_redistribution, test_agpl_blocks_network_service_reuse, test_a_blocked_candidate_does_not_hide_an_acceptable_one, test_unlicensed_candidate_is_blocked_and_never_registered_as_usable.

AC6 discovery has no execution or production activation authority: Assessment refuses to construct with any authorizes_execution/activation/installation flag set, the registry exposes no install/execute/run/download/activate/enable/apply verb and a test enforces that absence, and every proposal states discovery_grants all false. Tests: test_assessment_refuses_to_grant_anything, test_registry_has_no_install_execute_or_download_verb, test_proposal_states_that_discovery_grants_nothing.

Deliverables: capability-gap classifier (classify_gap + GapKind), candidate registry/proposal schema (CapabilityCandidate, CandidateRegistry, render_proposal with a stable digest), and license/permission/dependency assessment (assess_license, assess_candidate).

stories.objective: Permit broad safe experimentation only inside a qualified, explicitly granted lab.
acceptance_criteria: Package/model/skill install and execution require the applicable experiment/network/resource grants
Untrusted candidates have no host mounts, production credentials or privileged runtime sockets
Install hooks/custom loaders and binaries are inspected and constrained
Every trial records exact versions, effects, checks, cost and cleanup outcome
Failure or unavailable qualification blocks trial; no host fallback
Successful task-local use does not silently become global capability or policy
implementation_rules: Read current producer/authority/executor/consumer paths; module existence is not integration proof.
Document alternatives, affected surfaces, pinned tests, risks and rollback before edits.

acceptance_evidence: AC1 install and execution require the applicable experiment/network/resource grants: admit() requires allow_install AND allow_code_execution, every grant boolean defaults false, an expired grant admits nothing, and a network grant is only valid when it names its hosts (named hosts without a network grant are rejected as contradictory). Tests: test_trial_needs_an_explicit_install_grant, test_trial_needs_an_explicit_execution_grant, test_expired_grant_admits_nothing, test_network_grant_must_name_its_hosts, test_hosts_without_a_network_grant_are_contradictory, test_negative_budgets_are_refused, test_a_grant_without_a_resource_budget_admits_nothing, test_admission_answer_does_not_depend_on_call_order.

AC2 untrusted candidates get no host mounts, production credentials or privileged runtime sockets: TrialSpec refuses to construct with host mounts (checked against sensitive roots and their sub-paths, so /etc/ssl/private fails), privileged runtime sockets (docker/containerd/podman), uses_production_credentials, or credential-shaped environment keys; containment is a construction-time refusal. Tests: the test_host_mounts_are_refused parametrisation, test_a_subpath_of_a_sensitive_root_is_also_refused, test_production_credentials_are_refused, the test_privileged_runtime_sockets_are_refused parametrisation, the test_credential_shaped_environment_keys_are_refused parametrisation, test_ordinary_environment_keys_are_allowed.

AC3 install hooks, custom loaders and binaries are inspected and constrained; uninspected surface blocks: inspect_candidate() returns a blocking finding for every hook, loader and binary absent from the inspected set and a blocking provenance finding for a missing or malformed digest; admit_with_inspection admits only when nothing blocks. Tests: test_uninspected_hooks_block_the_trial, test_inspecting_the_surface_allows_the_trial, test_missing_digest_is_a_blocking_provenance_finding, test_inspection_records_each_surface_item, test_bad_digest_format_is_refused.

AC4 every trial records exact versions, effects, checks, cost and cleanup outcome: TrialReceipt carries versions, commands, effects, checks, cost, the findings that admitted it and the cleanup outcome; 'completed' requires cleanup.succeeded; a run that failed or failed to clean up is 'failed'; a crashing runner yields a failed receipt with the error rather than an exception; the lab removes its own scratch directory and records it; receipts carry does_not_prove and a stable digest. Tests: test_completed_trial_records_versions_effects_checks_cost_and_cleanup, test_a_failed_trial_is_not_a_completed_trial, test_a_trial_with_failed_cleanup_is_failed_even_if_the_run_succeeded, test_a_crashing_runner_is_a_failed_trial_with_the_error_recorded, test_the_lab_removes_its_own_scratch_directory, test_receipt_states_what_it_does_not_prove, test_a_completed_receipt_requires_successful_cleanup, test_a_receipt_that_ran_must_record_when_it_finished, test_receipt_digest_is_stable.

AC5 failure OR unavailable qualification blocks the trial; no host fallback: only QualificationState.QUALIFIED admits, a qualified host must name both a qualification record and a fingerprint, not_measured forbids observation fields, and both not_measured and observed_unqualified refuse; a refusal is an auditable receipt (admission 'refused' with a reason) and the runner is never called; no type carries a host_fallback/allow_unqualified/skip_qualification/force parameter. measured_inventory is not_measured on main, so the shipped configuration refuses every trial. Tests: test_not_measured_host_admits_nothing, test_observed_but_unqualified_host_admits_nothing, test_qualified_host_admits_trials, test_a_qualified_host_must_name_its_record_and_fingerprint, test_not_measured_cannot_carry_observations, test_refused_trial_on_unmeasured_host_is_recorded_not_run, test_the_real_shipped_gate_refuses_with_the_current_inventory, test_there_is_no_host_fallback_parameter.

AC6 successful task-local use does not silently become global capability or policy: a completed trial leaves Lab.promotions empty and every receipt states grants_global_capability false; record_promotion accepts only a completed trial and requires owner_approved, and the record it writes is scope 'task-local'; render_receipts states lab_grants false for production_activation, global_capability and host_fallback. Tests: test_a_successful_trial_does_not_promote_itself, test_promotion_requires_owner_approval, test_only_a_completed_trial_can_be_promoted, test_recorded_promotion_names_the_owner_and_scope, test_rendered_receipts_are_json_with_sorted_keys.

Deliverables beyond the six criteria: the environment/lifecycle (Lab.admit/run_trial with a disposable per-trial scratch directory that is removed), quarantine/revoke (quarantine writes a marker citing the receipt digest, is_quarantined reads it, quarantining a receipt-less trial is refused), and deterministic receipts (sorted-key JSON, trailing newline, stable digest) are covered by test_quarantine_records_a_marker_and_cites_the_receipt, test_quarantine_of_an_unknown_trial_is_refused, test_receipt_redacts_credential_shaped_content_at_serialisation, test_running_without_a_runner_is_a_configuration_error, test_bad_trial_id_is_refused, test_missing_task_id_is_refused, test_unknown_qualification_status_is_refused.

stories.objective: Evaluate exact model configurations instead of routing by brand or parameter count.
acceptance_criteria: Profiles include runtime/checkpoint/quantisation/template/context/tool/vision support and measurement provenance

MoE internal experts are not treated as separately loadable coding/writing agents without a specifically verified runtime capability
implementation_rules: Read current producer/authority/executor/consumer paths; module existence is not integration proof.
Document alternatives, affected surfaces, pinned tests, risks and rollback before edits.

acceptance_evidence: AC1 profiles include runtime/checkpoint/quantisation/template/context/tool/vision support and measurement provenance: ConfigurationIdentity requires model id, checkpoint digest and revision, runtime and runtime version, quantisation, template, context length and a hardware fingerprint, and its digest changes with each; CompatibilityClaim records runtime/architecture feature support (tools, vision, schema) as supported/unsupported/unknown; every measurement carries provenance. A profile refuses a measurement belonging to a different configuration. Tests: test_identity_records_runtime_checkpoint_quantization_template_and_context, test_identity_digest_changes_with_quantization, test_identity_digest_changes_with_template, test_identity_digest_changes_with_runtime_version, test_identity_digest_changes_with_hardware, test_profile_carries_measurement_provenance, test_a_measurement_from_another_configuration_is_refused, test_runtime_feature_support_is_three_valued.

AC2 separate model companions/artifacts, installed disk inventory, readiness and residency: ModelCompanion is a separate artifact with its own digest, size and optional checkpoint binding; InstalledFootprint counts weights, companions and KV-cache separately; Readiness is ready/not_installed/incompatible/unknown and unknown is not ready; ResidencyState is a timestamped observation with resident bytes. Tests: test_companion_is_separate_from_the_checkpoint, test_a_missing_companion_makes_a_configuration_unready, test_a_companion_bound_to_another_checkpoint_is_incompatible, test_installed_footprint_counts_only_present_companions, test_readiness_unknown_is_not_ready, test_readiness_ready_requires_verified_runtime_support, test_unsupported_runtime_architecture_is_incompatible, test_residency_is_an_observation_with_a_timestamp, test_a_resident_model_must_report_its_bytes, test_installed_and_loaded_are_independent.

AC3 writing, coding, architecture, source handling and schema/tool reliability measured separately: the five kinds have distinct slots; summarise_task_probes takes one kind and raises on mixed probes; failed probes count as samples; confidence needs three probes and a bounded spread. Tests: test_the_five_task_kinds_are_named, the test_each_task_kind_measures_to_its_own_slot parametrisation, test_task_kinds_do_not_pool_into_one_score, test_probes_of_different_kinds_are_refused_rather_than_pooled, test_a_probe_from_another_configuration_is_refused, test_failed_probes_still_count_as_samples, test_a_single_probe_is_not_confident, test_unstable_probes_are_not_confident, test_measured_kinds_and_unknown_kinds_are_reported_separately.

AC4 model-card claims and imported benchmarks are not local qualification: Claim carries no value field and always serialises qualifies false; a Measurement from model_card/imported_benchmark/vendor_claim is stored but qualifies false, and capability() reports unknown naming the provenance; only local_probe, attributed to this configuration, qualifies. Tests: the test_a_non_local_measurement_never_qualifies parametrisation, test_a_profile_holding_only_a_model_card_claim_reports_unknown, test_a_model_card_claim_cannot_raise_a_refusal_to_an_allow, test_claims_are_recorded_but_carry_no_value, test_a_claim_cannot_impersonate_a_local_probe, test_a_claim_mentioning_a_task_still_yields_unknown_with_a_reason, test_a_local_probe_must_name_the_configuration_it_measured.

AC5 unknown capabilities fail explicitly and manual overrides remain bounded: require_capability allows only a confident local measurement, refuses unknown/claim/indicative, and degrades (never allows) from an active ManualOverride; overrides name one configuration and task kind, expire, cannot override an existing measurement, and a caller can refuse them. Tests: test_an_unmeasured_capability_refuses_by_default, test_a_measured_confident_capability_allows, test_an_indicative_but_unstable_measurement_does_not_allow, test_an_operator_override_degrades_and_never_allows, test_an_expired_override_is_ignored, test_an_override_is_bounded_to_one_configuration, test_an_override_cannot_be_used_by_a_caller_that_refuses_it, test_an_override_never_contradicts_a_measurement, test_unknown_capability_is_reported_as_unknown_not_as_zero.

AC6 Mistral/TwIL/Qwen/Gemma role suggestions remain hypotheses until tested: default_role_hypotheses creates all four untested; a confident local measurement can support or contradict one, a model card cannot, and a supported hypothesis names the exact configuration it was tested on; is_qualification is false for every status. acceptance_evidence: AC1 compatibility, measured quality, grants and actual resource fit all precede dispatch: GATE_ORDER fixes five gates evaluated in order before any dispatch could occur, each gate function is separately testable, `unknown` blocks rather than passing, and resource fit uses currently free bytes rather than total capacity. AC1 (continued) every gate is recorded even when a block prevents reaching it: the decision records all five gates per candidate, with not_reached marking the gates never asked, so silence is never mistaken for a pass. Tests: test_the_decision_records_every_gate_even_after_a_block, test_a_candidate_blocked_on_grants_still_reports_that_it_would_fit.

AC2 no unsupported simultaneous residency or dormant native activation: the scheduler plans strictly sequentially, a switch must name its unload, a step cannot load and unload the same model, and validate_sequential_plan replays the plan and refuses any load while another model is resident; every step mapping carries simultaneous_residency false and activates_native_lifecycle false. Tests: test_a_switch_must_name_what_it_unloads, test_a_step_cannot_load_and_unload_the_same_model, test_loading_while_another_model_is_resident_is_refused, test_a_sequential_plan_unloads_before_each_load, test_a_repeated_model_is_kept_resident_rather_than_reloaded, test_a_plan_that_already_holds_a_model_switches_rather_than_stacking, test_no_plan_step_activates_native_lifecycle.

AC3 all model inference remains local and hosted fallback is refused even when local fit or quality is insufficient, with a scoped limitation reported instead: LocalCandidate refuses is_hosted at construction; no decision type can represent a hosted provider; when nothing local qualifies the decision carries a ScopedLimitation naming the shortfall and remedy with hosted_fallback_offered false, and the module exposes HOSTED_FALLBACK_AVAILABLE as a constant false plus a refusal that raises rather than returning something a caller could branch on. Tests: test_a_hosted_candidate_is_refused_at_construction, test_there_is_no_hosted_fallback_to_call, test_when_nothing_qualifies_the_decision_reports_a_limitation, test_a_limitation_names_the_local_shortfall, test_a_decision_that_selects_nothing_without_a_limitation_is_refused, test_no_module_type_offers_a_hosted_provider_path, test_a_claim_is_not_quality_evidence.

AC4 load/unload accounting is not confused with physical completion and uncertainty remains charged: MemoryAccounting keeps charged, observed and free separate; the effective charge is raised to the observed figure when the runtime reports more; the charge is released only on a released observation with nothing resident; an unknown observation leaves the charge standing; accounting_gap reports the unevidenced difference without releasing it and is_settled means the runtime resolved it. AC3 continuation probes verify decisions and artifact trails, not only summary readability: probes declare a kind (decision/artifact/approval/authority/failure/preference) and the facts a correct answer must contain; a readability probe is refused at construction; a bank reports coverage and uncovered kinds so many probes on one decision cannot pass as thorough; every probe must pass in full. Proved by tests/test_direction_checkpoints.py (15 tests) and by scripts/harness_direction_walk.mjs check 1 against a fixture staged through the route (22/22 browser checks).

AC2 (the sample passes basic technical checks and names the feedback needed): a SampleArtifact with any failing technical_checks is refused with 400 and never offered for judgement; a sample whose digest is not a digest is refused. The checkpoint carries feedback_prompt and feedback_points, drawn by the panel and asserted in the jsdom probe. Tests: test_a_sample_that_failed_its_checks_is_not_offered_for_judgement, test_a_broken_sample_is_not_offered_for_judgement, test_a_sample_digest_that_is_not_a_digest_is_refused.

AC3 (the feedback pause preserves artifacts, job state and draft): the pause is a running -> waiting_approval transition in the existing durable state machine, taken in the same transaction as the checkpoint evidence, so the checkpoint, the event log and the task record all survive a reconnect. Recovered from the transition log by a reader that never saw the writer (test_the_pause_survives_a_fresh_process_read, walk check 8). No new table and no new task state.

AC4 (direction approval is not final acceptance and grants no publish permission): direction_approval_is_final_acceptance and direction_approval_grants_publish_permission are init=False constants; constructing the dataclass with True raises TypeError (test_direction_approval_never_implies_acceptance_or_publish_permission). from_mapping() refuses a stored record whose flags are not False, so an edited row cannot become permission. The answer route returns both as false, and the pane states the limit beside the buttons.

AC5 (benchmarked similar tasks skip the check-in but escalate material uncertainty): decide() returns benchmark_covered with pauses_production=False, and the route answers status=skipped without moving the task; walk check 6 asserts a covered task is left running with no panel. A material uncertainty is evaluated BEFORE coverage, so a benchmark never swallows an escalation (walk check and test_material_uncertainty_escalates_even_when_benchmarked). Free-form uncertainty strings cannot escalate.

AC6 (satisfies docs/autonomous-production-ux-direction.md): the panel is drawn from durable server state, keeps direction approval, final acceptance and reference adoption distinct in the pane, and draws unknown values as unknown. The checkpoint is version-bound, so an answer given about a different version is refused and the pause survives (the stale-selection rule AP-019 generalises). Verified at the DOM level by scripts/ui-probes/direction-panel.mjs, including a hostile sample id rendered as text, and in Chromium by the walk (checks 2, 3, 7).

Refused on purpose: no UI-driven acceptance, no reference adoption, no publish path. The answer route writes no acceptance and adopts no benchmark (test_the_answer_route_never_writes_acceptance_or_adopts_a_benchmark).

AC2 (feedback pins the artifact version and preserves the original wording): capture() requires the artifact digest as well as the id, verbatim is never rewritten, and the stale section draws an older comment in the words it was given. Proved by test_a_comment_is_recorded_against_exactly_one_version and walk checks 1 and 6.

AC3 (material interpretation confirmed; ambiguity and conflicts not silently generalised): the confirmation gate makes plan_revision().ready false until the owner says which reading they meant; a preference cannot be captured from one comment and cannot carry a selection; two live comments on one region that cannot both be acted on are reported as a pair. AC4 (a revision invalidates only affected downstream evidence/approvals): plan_revision() includes only feedback whose digest equals the base, stale_for() returns the rest, and affected_evidence() narrows invalidation to references naming that digest. Proved by test_feedback_on_an_older_version_is_reported_stale_not_applied and walk check 6.

AC5 (a retained preference can be corrected, deleted and inspected): each item prints its reach, offers 'This is what I meant' and 'Withdraw', and a withdrawal is a tombstone rather than a row delete. Proved by test_a_retained_preference_can_be_inspected_and_removed, test_withdrawing_feedback_keeps_the_record_and_clears_the_live_set and walk checks 4 and 8.

AC6 (keyboard, mobile and zoom remain usable; paused work resumes): the composer is a real textarea reachable by keyboard and the region rows activate through the app's single delegated data-key-activate handler, which the keyboard contract pins as the eighth such control. The pane is drawn at 390x844 and at 200% zoom without horizontal overflow and survives a reload from the record. Feedback writes no task state at all, so a paused run is untouched. Proved by walk check 10 and tests/test_keyboard_a11y.py.

AC7 (the direction rules in docs/autonomous-production-ux-direction.md): the pane keeps direction approval, final acceptance and publish permission distinct in its own words, and every record and revision emits is_final_acceptance false and grants_publish_permission false -- from_mapping() refuses a stored payload that claims otherwise. Documented in docs/ap019-scoped-feedback.md.

Refused on purpose: no acceptance, no publish permission, no benchmark adoption, no runtime activation. A comment that cannot name its version is refused, because it could never be checked for staleness later.

acceptance_evidence: AC1 (record the original brief, exact artifact, user provenance, approval scope, checks and configuration): ArtifactVersion carries content_sha256 plus optional identity_sha256/identity_basis/producer/producer_version/config_sha256; a 'content+provenance' identity without its digest is refused rather than downgraded and 'content_only' never presents itself as full provenance. Proved by tests/test_reference_benchmarks.py::test_a_reference_records_the_brief_artifact_provenance_scope_and_checks, ::test_a_content_only_identity_never_presents_itself_as_a_full_one and ::test_a_provenance_identity_without_its_digest_is_refused, plus tests/test_reference_benchmark_routes.py::test_a_reference_needs_the_exact_artifact_and_its_digest.

AC2 (continue-direction, final-acceptance, use-as-reference and publish grants are separate): APPROVAL_KINDS names all four; Reference raises if it carries is_final_acceptance or grants_publish_permission and from_mapping refuses a stored row claiming either; accept() refuses an approval that accepted the artifact but did not grant use_as_reference. Proved by test_approving_a_reference_is_not_approving_the_artifact_or_publishing_it, test_an_approval_that_accepted_the_artifact_but_did_not_adopt_it_is_refused and test_a_stored_record_claiming_publish_permission_is_refused_at_read_time.

AC3 (enhancements create a new version; prior acceptance cannot be silently rewritten): enhance() refuses a version that does not increase and requires a fresh approval; supersede() writes only the forward link; ReferenceStore.put() refuses a changed approval or a redirected artifact digest. Proved by test_enhancing_creates_a_new_version_with_its_own_approval, test_superseding_links_forward_without_altering_the_earlier_acceptance, test_the_store_refuses_to_rewrite_an_acceptance and the route test test_an_enhancement_adds_a_version_and_leaves_the_first_acceptance_intact.

AC4 (retrieval by relevant audience/language/task/style, never forcing identical layouts): rank() scores task kind, audience, language and style tags, labels a language mismatch instead of hiding it, skips revoked and superseded versions, and never scores layout. Proved by test_retrieval_prefers_a_reference_for_the_same_audience_language_and_task, test_retrieval_never_scores_layout_because_layout_must_not_be_copied and test_a_reference_for_another_language_is_labelled_rather_than_silently_offered, plus scripts/ui-probes/reference-panel.mjs.

AC5 (the agent cannot synthesize owner approval, security sign-off or screenshot approval): OwnerApproval requires an actor namespaced owner:/user:/reviewer: and refuses six machine names at construction and again at from_mapping; the pane has no stored identity it could borrow, requires a typed approver name and the owner's own words, and sends nothing without them. Proved by test_a_machine_actor_cannot_approve_anything, test_a_stored_record_with_a_machine_approver_is_refused_at_read_time, test_an_agent_cannot_record_its_own_approval and the probe's refusal check.

AC6 (changed facts/code/assets still require new verification despite a style reference): verification_still_required() maps code/facts/assets/screenshots/any change to the obligations a reference can never discharge, REFERENCE_CANNOT_SETTLE names them once, and every coverage answer returns the list beside the coverage. Proved by test_a_style_reference_does_not_settle_changed_code, test_changed_facts_and_assets_carry_their_own_obligations, test_coverage_names_the_obligations_a_changed_artifact_brings and the probe check that the pane names what a reference never settles.

AC7 (docs/autonomous-production-ux-direction.md satisfied, existing features preserved, actual implementation review): direction approval, final acceptance, reference adoption and publish permission stay distinct in the record, the routes and the pane's own words; the pane writes no task state so a paused-for-direction task is untouched; the reference pane in the evidence dialog is the shipped implementation, probed at the DOM level by scripts/ui-probes/reference-panel.mjs. Regenerated artifacts: source manifest, control inventory, route map, authorization trace, preservation matrix/signoff/E2E, adversarial inventory, keyboard a11y inventory, release gate (37/37 checks, 7/7 gates, 0 findings).

Discipline: reference_benchmarks.py is a pure decision module (no clock, no environment, no network, no file at import); a test enforces it, and another enforces that it shares no top-level name with app.py because a collision in the single-file build once replaced the app's SCHEMA_VERSION.

Hole closed (AC7, and the reason the story exists): app.py's direction route built BenchmarkCoverage from the request body and silently skipped any row that was not a dict, so a caller could assert that the owner had already approved a reference -- including a digest it invented -- and the task would be told the direction was settled. Tightening the validation would not have fixed it; the row had to be looked up in the store. The route now reads coverage from stored, owner-approved references, derives the project scope from the session rather than the request, and refuses a named reference the project does not hold instead of skipping it. Proved by the direction-route coverage tests and by tests/test_harness_ap_walks_browser.py, which pins the refusal message and the absence of the old `benchmarks` field. This defect is why the AP-018 fixture broke, which is recorded in AP-018.

acceptance_evidence: AC1 (no implicit startup/background outbound requests; schedules require explicit grant): WatchSchedule refuses to exist without a WatchGrant, whose granted_by must be namespaced to a human (owner:/user:/reviewer:) and whose hosts must be a subset of autonomous_production_research.PUBLIC_READ_ALLOWLIST; Watcher exposes no start/daemon/loop and only ticks a supplied schedule with an injected fetcher, reporting starts_itself: False. assert_no_implicit_egress parses this module's own source (AST, not substring, because the function's text names what it forbids) and refuses socket/ssl/threading/asyncio/sched/schedule/requests/httpx/urllib/subprocess imports, create_task/ensure_future/Thread/Timer/sleep calls and while True. Tests: test_a_schedule_cannot_exist_without_a_grant, test_a_grant_needs_a_named_human_author, test_a_grant_cannot_authorise_a_host_outside_the_public_read_allowlist, test_the_watcher_has_no_start_and_no_loop, test_the_module_carries_no_network_or_background_machinery, test_the_module_reads_no_clock_and_opens_no_socket, test_a_round_gets_its_time_from_the_caller.

AC1b (the cap is checked before the round, so an over-budget round costs nothing) and expiry: tick() refuses when requests_used + len(locations) exceeds the grant cap and when the grant has expired, both raised before fetcher is called -- asserted by recording calls on a FakeFetcher. Tests: test_the_request_cap_is_enforced_before_the_round_runs, test_an_expired_grant_makes_no_requests_at_all, test_a_refused_round_reports_the_reason_it_was_refused.

AC2 (model cards/papers/repos capture dates, exact versions, licence and limitations): CandidateCard requires kind from CANDIDATE_KINDS (model/paper/repo/prompt/skill/config), an exact version, a captured_on date, a licence and non-empty limitations; the moving targets latest/main/HEAD/master/newest/* are refused as versions; the source_url is validated against the public read allowlist. Tests: test_a_candidate_records_version_date_licence_and_limits, test_a_moving_target_is_not_a_version, test_a_candidate_with_no_stated_limitation_is_a_recommendation, test_a_candidate_from_outside_the_read_allowlist_is_refused, test_a_candidate_needs_a_capture_date.

stories.objective: Improve outputs without endless criticism, scope growth or degraded rewrites.
acceptance_criteria: Unchanged output is always an eligible candidate
