acceptance_evidence: AC1 (unchanged output is always an eligible candidate): RefinementSession.start() requires an incumbent Variant (origin='incumbent', revision 0) and starts with it accepted; RefinementRound is refused unless the incumbent appears exactly once on the ballot with this session's id and digest; a revision/synthesis carrying the incumbent's content digest raises SelectionRefused; the currently accepted version must be present with unchanged content in every round; every ballot entry needs at least one verdict. Tests: test_the_incumbent_starts_as_the_accepted_version, test_a_session_cannot_start_from_a_revision, test_a_ballot_without_the_incumbent_is_refused, test_a_ballot_with_two_incumbents_is_refused, test_a_revision_that_did_not_change_anything_is_not_a_revision, test_the_accepted_version_must_defend_itself_in_every_round, test_an_unjudged_variant_is_not_a_candidate, test_every_ballot_entry_is_reported_with_its_own_verdict.

AC2 (independent-context comparison records potential shared-model bias): ReviewerContext pins model_family, session_id and rubric_digest per verdict; a verdict from the variant's authoring session raises ComparisonRefused (self-grading), and a multi-variant comparison with fewer than two sessions is refused. RoundOutcome.shared_model_bias is derived per round and can only be 'possible' or 'mitigated_by_independent_context' -- there is no 'none' state, so one model family cannot certify itself unbiased. Tests: test_a_reviewer_from_the_producing_session_is_refused, test_one_session_judging_both_sides_is_one_opinion, test_a_shared_model_family_is_recorded_as_possible_bias, test_a_different_model_family_in_another_session_mitigates_but_never_clears_the_bias.

AC3 (hard factual/functional/safety requirements cannot be traded for style scores): Requirement.is_hard is derived from kind (factual/functional/safety), not a settable flag; a variant failing any hard requirement is ineligible and its style score is not used for selection, and a missing hard result is an ineligible reason rather than a pass; RequirementResult(passed=True) with no evidence raises EvidenceRefused while a failure needs none. Tests: test_a_hard_failure_makes_a_high_style_score_ineligible, test_a_missing_hard_result_is_not_a_pass, test_a_style_requirement_is_never_hard, test_a_hard_pass_without_evidence_is_refused, test_a_failed_requirement_needs_no_evidence_to_be_recorded, test_an_unknown_requirement_kind_is_refused, test_style_never_rescues_a_safety_failure.

AC4 (iterations and total budget bounded across all reviewers/variants): RefinementLimits bounds max_rounds, max_reviewer_calls and max_tokens for the whole session; apply() charges len(verdicts) calls and the declared tokens against those ceilings before any scoring, so a refused round records nothing and leaves the session unchanged; rounds must arrive in order; a no_progress_rounds limit above max_rounds is refused as unreachable. Tests: test_the_reviewer_budget_counts_every_reviewer_of_every_variant, test_a_budget_refusal_records_nothing, test_the_round_limit_is_a_ceiling, test_the_token_budget_covers_the_whole_session, test_a_plateau_limit_beyond_the_round_limit_is_refused, test_rounds_cannot_arrive_out_of_order.

AC5 (stop when evidence does not justify change and preserve best accepted version): stop_decision() returns goal_met/no_progress/budget_exhausted/rounds_exhausted/capability_gap/insufficient_evidence; change_justified is true only for goal_met with an accepted version differing from the incumbent and StopDecision raises otherwise; a candidate must beat the accepted style by min_improvement to be adopted, a lost round never replaces the accepted version, and the preserved variant is always the accepted one. Tests: test_a_justified_improvement_is_accepted, test_a_margin_too_small_to_matter_keeps_the_incumbent, test_two_rounds_without_progress_stop_the_session, test_a_round_that_loses_does_not_replace_the_accepted_version, test_a_selection_cannot_be_justified_by_a_non_goal_stop, test_running_out_of_rounds_preserves_the_accepted_version, test_no_round_yet_is_not_a_stop_and_not_a_claim, test_a_round_where_nothing_is_eligible_is_not_evidence_for_a_change.

AC6 (insufficient capability produces honest partial result and precise escalation, not fabricated success): Escalation requires a concrete capability, why it was needed, evidence of the gap and a namespaced human decision owner (owner:/user:/reviewer:); recording one makes the report status 'partial' and stop kind 'capability_gap'; claim_success() raises FabricatedSuccessRefused on a partial report; a report that never escalated and whose accepted version kept every hard requirement reports 'delivered' and states either the accepted revision or the kept incumbent. Tests: test_a_capability_gap_makes_the_result_partial, test_a_partial_result_cannot_be_reported_as_delivered, test_an_escalation_must_name_a_human_decision_owner, test_an_escalation_needs_evidence_of_the_gap, test_a_delivered_report_states_its_success_plainly, test_a_delivered_report_may_still_keep_the_incumbent, test_the_report_never_claims_a_hard_requirement_was_traded, test_the_report_is_reproducible, test_the_report_records_the_spend_it_used, test_a_wall_clock_measurement_has_to_come_from_the_caller.
Discipline: test_the_module_reads_no_clock_and_opens_no_socket (AST import allowlist) and test_the_module_has_no_top_level_state_that_outlives_a_session.
